unit.title: Unit 2 · Cụm từ giao tiếp hằng ngày

words.definition: how much something costs
words.example: What is the price of this bag?
words.exampleVi: Cái túi này giá bao nhiêu?

words.definition: not costing much money
words.example: This shirt is cheap.
words.exampleVi: Cái áo này rẻ.

words.definition: costing a lot of money
words.example: That phone is too expensive.
words.exampleVi: Cái điện thoại đó đắt quá.

words.definition: a lower price than usual
words.example: There is a ten percent discount today.
words.exampleVi: Hôm nay có giảm giá mười phần trăm.

words.definition: a paper that shows what you paid for
words.example: Can I have the receipt, please?
words.exampleVi: Cho mình xin hóa đơn nhé.

words.definition: how big or small something is
words.example: Do you have a smaller size?
words.exampleVi: Bạn có cỡ nhỏ hơn không?

words.definition: a pain in your head
words.example: I have a headache today.
words.exampleVi: Hôm nay mình bị đau đầu.

words.definition: something you take to feel better
words.example: Take this medicine twice a day.
words.exampleVi: Uống thuốc này hai lần mỗi ngày.

words.definition: to relax and stop working
words.example: You should rest at home.
words.exampleVi: Bạn nên nghỉ ngơi ở nhà.

words.definition: when your body is too hot because you are ill
words.example: She has a fever.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy bị sốt.

words.definition: the sound you make to clear your throat
words.example: I've had a bad cough for a week.
words.exampleVi: Mình ho nặng cả tuần nay.

words.definition: a planned time to meet someone
words.example: I have a doctor's appointment at ten.
words.exampleVi: Mình có lịch hẹn bác sĩ lúc mười giờ.

words.definition: in a line without turning
words.example: Go straight for two blocks.
words.exampleVi: Đi thẳng hai dãy nhà.

words.definition: the place where two streets meet
words.example: The bank is on the corner.
words.exampleVi: Ngân hàng nằm ở góc phố.

words.definition: on the other side of
words.example: The café is opposite the station.
words.exampleVi: Quán cà phê đối diện nhà ga.

words.definition: not far away
words.example: Is there a bank near here?
words.exampleVi: Gần đây có ngân hàng không?

words.definition: a light that tells cars when to stop or go
words.example: Turn left at the traffic light.
words.exampleVi: Rẽ trái ở chỗ đèn giao thông.

unit.title: Unit 1 · Diễn đạt cảm xúc và ý kiến

words.definition: a little angry
words.example: I was annoyed when the bus was late.
words.exampleVi: Mình bực khi xe buýt đến trễ.

words.definition: worried and nervous
words.example: She felt anxious before the exam.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy lo lắng trước kỳ thi.

words.definition: happy because a problem is over
words.example: I was so relieved to pass.
words.exampleVi: Mình nhẹ nhõm vì đã đậu.

words.definition: sad because something was not as good as you hoped
words.example: We were disappointed with the hotel.
words.exampleVi: Bọn mình thất vọng về khách sạn.

words.definition: feeling shy or uncomfortable
words.example: He felt embarrassed about his mistake.
words.exampleVi: Anh ấy xấu hổ vì lỗi của mình.

words.definition: extremely happy and excited
words.example: They were thrilled to win.
words.exampleVi: Họ rất phấn khích khi thắng.

words.definition: to have the same opinion
words.example: I agree with you.
words.exampleVi: Mình đồng ý với bạn.

words.definition: to like one thing more than another
words.example: I prefer tea to coffee.
words.exampleVi: Mình thích trà hơn cà phê.

words.definition: to give an idea for someone to consider
words.example: I suggest we leave early.
words.exampleVi: Mình đề nghị chúng ta đi sớm.

words.definition: to give reasons for or against something
words.example: Some people argue that it is too expensive.
words.exampleVi: Một số người cho rằng nó quá đắt.

words.definition: to make someone believe something
words.example: She convinced me to try it.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy thuyết phục mình thử.

words.definition: used to say what you really think
words.example: Honestly, I didn't enjoy the film.
words.exampleVi: Thật lòng thì mình không thích bộ phim.

words.definition: the time by which something must be finished
words.example: The deadline is on Friday.
words.exampleVi: Hạn chót là thứ Sáu.

words.definition: a person you work with
words.example: My colleague is very helpful.
words.exampleVi: Đồng nghiệp của mình rất hay giúp đỡ.

words.definition: an event where people talk about work
words.example: I have a meeting at nine.
words.exampleVi: Mình có cuộc họp lúc chín giờ.

words.definition: a plan of when things will happen
words.example: My schedule is very busy this week.
words.exampleVi: Tuần này lịch của mình rất bận.

words.definition: to succeed in doing something difficult
words.example: I managed to finish on time.
words.exampleVi: Mình xoay xở xong đúng hạn.

unit.title: Unit 1 · Từ và cụm từ để nói trôi chảy

lessons.title: Từ nối để nói mạch lạc

words.definition: used to add a contrasting idea
words.example: It's cheap. However, the quality is poor.
words.exampleVi: Nó rẻ. Tuy nhiên, chất lượng kém.

words.definition: used to show a result
words.example: It rained, therefore we stayed in.
words.exampleVi: Trời mưa, vì vậy bọn mình ở nhà.

words.definition: used to show a contrast within a sentence
words.example: Although it was late, we kept working.
words.exampleVi: Mặc dù đã muộn, bọn mình vẫn làm tiếp.

words.definition: used to add more information
words.example: In addition, the staff were friendly.
words.exampleVi: Ngoài ra, nhân viên rất thân thiện.

words.definition: used to introduce a consequence
words.example: As a result, sales went up.
words.exampleVi: Kết quả là doanh số tăng.

words.definition: used to give a general view
words.example: On the whole, I enjoyed the trip.
words.exampleVi: Nhìn chung mình thích chuyến đi.

lessons.title: Cụm từ câu giờ khi suy nghĩ

words.definition: used when you pause to think
words.example: Well, it depends on the situation.
words.exampleVi: À thì, còn tùy tình huống.

words.definition: used to say what you really think
words.example: To be honest, I'm not sure.
words.exampleVi: Thật lòng thì mình không chắc.

words.definition: used to buy time before answering
words.example: Let me think... I'd say about ten.
words.exampleVi: Để mình nghĩ đã... chắc khoảng mười.

words.definition: used to explain more clearly
words.example: What I mean is, it's too risky.
words.exampleVi: Ý mình là nó quá rủi ro.

words.definition: used when you are not certain
words.example: It's hard to say, but I think so.
words.exampleVi: Khó nói lắm, nhưng mình nghĩ vậy.

words.definition: used when you suddenly remember something
words.example: Come to think of it, I saw him yesterday.
words.exampleVi: Nghĩ lại thì hôm qua mình có gặp anh ấy.

lessons.title: Cụm từ đi chung hay gặp

words.definition: to try hard to do something
words.example: She made an effort to speak English every day.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy nỗ lực nói tiếng Anh mỗi ngày.

words.definition: to use an opportunity well
words.example: Take advantage of free practice.
words.exampleVi: Hãy tận dụng buổi luyện tập miễn phí.

words.definition: to stay in contact with someone
words.example: Let's keep in touch.
words.exampleVi: Mình giữ liên lạc nhé.

words.definition: to have none left
words.example: We ran out of time.
words.exampleVi: Bọn mình hết thời gian.

words.definition: to become familiar with something
words.example: I'm getting used to the new job.
words.exampleVi: Mình đang quen dần với công việc mới.
